# lc.fall-hip-lateral

Kind: load_case. Status: **proposed** (PROPOSED: not yet accepted).

Lateral fall from standing, hip first.

Notes: The energy is a design upper edge, not a measurement. "Sourced" means the cited decision exists and is accepted, not that its number is validated. The hip zone has no cap yet; the cap and stroke are set by the owning record (adr-0044 D3), rm.v1-pelvis-structure. No energy is shared between zones or between limbs without a verified source (adr-0037 D1(c)). 540 J is the upper edge of the energy bound of adr-0037 D1(b), 473 to 537 J after its 2026-10-31 Revisions, rounded up to the next 10 J. No credit for leg buckling or bracing (adr-0036). S1 and S11 of data/falls/sources.md (both Verified) put the energy at 212 to 257 J and 107 to 163 J. They are calibration: they lower nothing until Freyja's own effective mass at the trochanter exists (adr-0037 D3, calibration, hip), and they are deliberately not in evidence.
